description: Authored pass/fault examples for method review, not actual gameplay or judge calibration.

cases.observation: View-dependent depth and occlusion occur in a responsive explorable room.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A static room illustration with UI buttons substitutes for spatial exploration.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Inputs change world position and the intended objects are reachable without teleport/debug actions.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Walking animation occurs without movement, or necessary objects are unreachable.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: The view changes coherently and player-facing interactions remain usable.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: View controls fail or looking away still acts on unrelated off-screen objects.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Solid geometry blocks penetration and ordinary route access still works.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Walls are cosmetic and the player passes through them.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Each key adds once, cannot be duplicated and remains recorded after moving away.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Inventory increments without interaction or repeated collection duplicates a key.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Far/occluded attempts leave inventory unchanged; nearby line-of-sight interaction succeeds.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: A global interact key collects a far or fully occluded item.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Neither one key nor proximity alone bypasses the chest; the badge is obtained from opening it and required for the exit.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Chest opens with one key, badge is pre-granted or exit ignores its badge condition.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Opening alone is not a win; crossing the now-open exit produces the terminal state.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Any interaction with the door declares victory before traversal, or crossing never ends the round.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: The new round restores all required locks and items and remains controllable.

expected.reason: Hypothetical complete observable behavior.

cases.observation: Badge/keys, an open chest/door or victory survives restart.

expected.reason: Hypothetical contradiction of an explicit requirement.

cases.observation: Only an attractive still image and creator claim are supplied; no corresponding input/action sequence was captured.

expected.reason: Static appearance cannot establish the required interaction.

cases.observation: The browser-control transport failed before the game could receive any ordinary input, and no artifact defect was established.

expected.reason: Evaluator infrastructure failure invalidates the measurement; it is not a game failure.
